Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Palm Harbor for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, all of them free. The magic runs from the Gingerbread Wars (December 3) through the Jingle Bell Ball (December 7), with Santa's Merry Meet and Greet and the Palm Harbor Christmas Parade, Tree Lighting and Holiday Market (both December 5) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Palm Harbor

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Palm Harbor
  • 4 free events, including the parade and tree lighting; some need registration and some sell food
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Merry Meet and Greet and the downtown tree lighting (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Palm Harbor Christmas Parade and Tree Lighting (December 5)
  • Trains: none in town; see the Largo page for the Rudolph Limited
  • Season: December 3 to December 7

Planning a bigger day out? Palm Harbor families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Tampa, which covers Busch Gardens Christmas Town, ZooTampa Lights and the Tampa Riverwalk boat parade.
